description: This file defines the CassandraClusteringOptions class, which provides configuration options for setting up Cassandra-based clustering in Orleans. It includes properties for TTL settings, retry delays, and methods for configuring Cassandra sessions.

classes.name: CassandraClusteringOptions
classes.description: Represents configuration options for Cassandra clustering in Orleans, including TTL behavior, retry delays, and session creation methods.

methods.name: GetCassandraTtlSeconds
methods.description: Calculates TTL seconds based on the configuration and cluster membership options.

methods.name: ConfigureClient
methods.description: Overloaded method to set up the Cassandra session creation using either a connection string or a custom configuration delegate.
